# Notable AI Creative Projects Since March 2023

## Visual & Generative Art

**Midjourney v6** (December 2023) - Major upgrade enabling photorealistic images with better text rendering and prompt following, leading to viral AI fashion photography and magazine covers

**DALL-E 3 + ChatGPT integration** (October 2023) - Made AI art generation conversational, spawning creative collaborations and illustrated storytelling projects

**Stability AI's SDXL** - Enhanced open-source image generation inspiring countless community art projects and fine-tuned models

## Music & Audio

**Suno AI v3** (March 2024) - Generated full songs with lyrics, vocals, and instrumentation; creators made entire albums and viral TikTok soundtracks

**Google's MusicLM** - Text-to-music generation enabling experimental sonic landscapes

**AI covers and voice cloning** - Viral trend of AI-generated covers featuring artists singing songs they never recorded (though ethically controversial)

## Video & Animation

**Runway Gen-2** - Text/image-to-video used in music videos, experimental films, and commercials

**Pika Labs** - Accessible video generation creating surreal, dreamlike animations

**AI-assisted short films** - Several festival entries and YouTube projects combining AI generation with traditional filmmaking

## Interactive & Experimental

**AI Dungeon masters** - Custom GPT-powered tabletop RPG experiences

**Personality-based chatbots** - Character.AI and similar platforms for creative writing and roleplay

**"Infinite" generated content** - Procedurally generated comics, choose-your-own-adventure stories, and virtual worlds

What type of AI creative work interests you most?
